name: VPS.NET SSD VPS

evidence.vps: 03: rented virtual server; the customer controls the OS and app and operates the server

line: Rent a Linux VPS and manage the operating system and apps.

free.text: Advertised $20 credit; V2+ purchase; current offer terms unverified

cells.regions: London UK, Salt Lake City US; Atlanta unclear

work.math: $5.50–$6.05 a month is a V1 server subtotal. 100 GB fits 2 TB only if data out uses the same unit. A 25 GB disk fits files. Builds, domain, HTTPS certificate and tax are extra or not priced.
$11–$12.10 a month V2 subtotal, but the pages disagree. 1 GB and 2 cores may not meet 1 GiB and 1 vCPU. The 3 TB transfer direction, throughput, builds, domain and tax are not verified.

$32–$34.70 a month lower-bound example: V4 at $27–$29.70 + backup from $5. The backup schedule and retention do not confirm 7 daily restore points. Capacity, extra backup, traffic and tax are not priced.
